toegepas.voor: om te drink en om kos te maak
toegepas.na: om te drink, om kos te maak
toegepas.rede_vinder: Three purposes strung together with 'en ... en' read woodenly; a list comma with one final 'en' is the natural form and saves a word.
toegepas.fout: Three purposes chained with 'en ... en' read woodenly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A list comma with one final 'en' is the natural Afrikaans form, keeps all three purposes and saves a word.

toegepas.voor: Hulle werk by klinieke en by hospitale en party ry
toegepas.na: Hulle werk by klinieke en by hospitale, en party ry
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Hulle werk' and 'party ry'), so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Hulle werk' and 'party ry').
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by AWS 2017 and also separates the clause from the 'klinieke en by hospitale' list, so the sentence no longer reads as one run-on.

toegepas.blok: Nie almal kom ewe maklik daaraan nie
toegepas.voor: maar almal kom nie ewe maklik daaraan nie
toegepas.na: maar nie almal kom ewe maklik daaraan nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'almal kom nie' can be read as 'nobody gets it easily'; putting 'nie' before 'almal' gives the intended 'not everyone' and matches the block heading.
toegepas.fout: 'almal kom nie' puts the negation after 'almal', an English-like scope that a reader can take as 'nobody'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'nie almal' is the natural Afrikaans form for 'not everyone', means the same unequal access, matches the block heading and leaves the word count unchanged.

laat_vaar.blok: Nie almal kom ewe maklik daaraan nie
laat_vaar.voor: Daar is ook huise in 'n stad sonder 'n kraan en plase met elektrisiteit en genoeg water.
laat_vaar.na: Party huise in 'n stad het geen kraan nie, en party plase het elektrisiteit en genoeg water.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: As written, 'sonder 'n kraan' can attach to 'stad' and 'sonder ... en plase' can read as 'without a tap and without farms'; two short clauses remove both misreadings with the same word count and meaning.
laat_vaar.fout: Slight possible misreading of what 'sonder' attaches to, but the sentence is readable as written.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The proposal drops 'Daar is ook', which marks these as counter-examples to the town-versus-remote pattern just described, so the contrast the original draws is weakened.

vlae.teks: Sonder skoon water of sonder mediese hulp word mense makliker siek.
vlae.rede: 'mediese hulp' seems to stand for the protected video term 'gesondheidsorg' taught two blocks earlier; if it means the same thing, a learner gets two words for one idea. Not changed, because whether it is meant to be narrower is a content question.
